nq.f: (informal) Initialism of newly qualified (a person that is newly qualified in some profession).

nqr.f: (informal, often euphemistic) Abbreviation of not quite right, chiefly used to denote a person, object, etc. that is abnormal in some way.

s.g: (informal, often euphemistic) A person or thing that is slightly wrong in some manner, as being damaged, incomplete, strange, imperfect, etc.
